title: Fix the time worked timer
request: The time worked timer on the tasks is incorrect. It seems to be timing based on when the task was first planned and never stops, even if agents do stop. It also blows the time out of proportion.

steps.title: Time worked comes from agent turns: each step sums its turns, the task counts overlapping turns once, nothing runs while no agent works (Dev)

report.summary: Time worked now from usage turns only; n9rt reads 12 min instead of 4492

steps.title: The task page and the tracker show the engine's time, live only while the step's agent is working (Design)

report.summary: Work page and tracker show recorded turn time only; live part only for an active step whose agent works now
